clue.text: In Trier got terrible skin irritation

indicators.note: terrible suggests the letters of the three words are in a mess and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone in the German city of Trier caught a nasty rash.
explanation.definitionFit: Intertrigo is a medical term for inflammation where skin folds rub together, a kind of rash.

clue.text: Muslim leader admits he's a Frenchman

parts.note: someone admitting he's a ... says I'm a, giving IMA
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: A Muslim cleric confesses to being French.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as the leader's own confession, 'he's a Frenchman' in his mouth becomes "I'm a M".
explanation.definitionFit: The cleric who leads prayers in a mosque bears this title.

clue.text: Omar's singer has a very small part

definitions.meaning: in FitzGerald's Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam the poet's companion is 'beside me singing in the wilderness'
a thousandth of an inch, an engineer's tiny measure

explanation.surface: A Persian poet's vocalist plays only a tiny role.
explanation.walkthrough: The Rubaiyat line runs 'A jug of wine, a loaf of bread, and ___ beside me singing in the wilderness'.
explanation.definitionFit: The companion addressed in the poem is the second-person pronoun, and engineers shorten one thousandth of an inch to the same word.

clue.text: He's not the type to settle for a very rich gem

definitions.text: He's not the type to settle

parts.note: rolling in it, so 'rolling' is slang for very rich
a precious stone is a gem

explanation.surface: A restless man won't make do with a merely valuable jewel.
explanation.walkthrough: From the proverb that a rover gathers no moss: someone who never stays put.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverbial wanderer who never puts down roots is this kind of person.

clue.text: Hurried one, in a way

indicators.note: in tells us the word for one sits within the word for a way

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
an ace is a one in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: Someone rushed, in a manner of speaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Raced means went fast, a synonym of hurried.

clue.text: Queen's terrible revenge incarcerating upper class individual

indicators.note: incarcerating means holding the other letters locked up inside
terrible says the letters of revenge are jumbled

parts.note: I stands for one, an individual

explanation.surface: A queen takes awful vengeance by jailing a posh person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' rearranges REVENGE into GNEVERE, and 'incarcerating' puts U and I inside it after the G.
explanation.definitionFit: She was the wife of King Arthur in the legends, a queen of Camelot.

clue.text: Prophet's claim to greatness

parts.note: a claim such as 'I am' asserts what one is, giving AM
OS is the abbreviation for outsize, great size

explanation.surface: A seer boasts of his own magnificence.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Prophet's' is read as 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: He was an Old Testament prophet with a book of the Bible under his name.

clue.text: Use fingers to eat a plum in the break

indicators.note: a break smashes things up, so these letters are broken and reassembled

explanation.surface: During an interval, you pick up a plum with your hands to eat it.
explanation.definitionFit: To handle something deftly with the hands is the root sense of this verb.

clue.text: Metal right, say, for making a joint

parts.note: silver is a precious metal
right is one side, an example of a side

explanation.surface: A recipe for a metallic piece for a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: Silverside is a cut of beef from the outer part of the rump, a joint for roasting or salting.

clue.text: Police at Communist Party riot in a fury

indicators.note: a riot is disorder, so the letters run wild

explanation.surface: Officers at a Communist Party riot are furious.
explanation.definitionFit: Apoplectic means overcome with rage, as if about to have a stroke.

clue.text: Shrub found in a Nilotic region

indicators.note: found in says the answer sits within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A bush grows in a region by the Nile.
explanation.definitionFit: The anil is the indigo plant, a shrub whose leaves yield dye.

clue.text: Devil the saint scolded showed his feelings

parts.note: a demon is a devil
rated is an old word for scolded

explanation.surface: A holy man berated the devil and let his emotions out.
explanation.definitionFit: Gave visible expression to emotions, as a protesting crowd does.

clue.text: Inn where medium met the archbishop

parts.note: medium means middle, in between
William Temple was Archbishop of Canterbury

explanation.surface: A psychic met a senior churchman at a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: Inn here is an Inn of Court, one of the four London societies of barristers, not a pub.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the four Inns of Court in London to which barristers belong.

clue.text: Drink with Dicky in the dockyard area

parts.note: water is a drink
a dicky is a false shirt front

explanation.surface: Someone drinks with a man called Dicky down at the docks.
explanation.definitionFit: The part of a town beside a harbour, with its quays and wharves.

clue.text: Fix beforehand to put pawn on back row

parts.note: P is the chess abbreviation for pawn
rear means back
a range is a row, as of mountains

explanation.surface: A chess player plots ahead to move a pawn to the back rank.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrange in advance is to organise something before it happens.

clue.text: A grocer with an awful pride

indicators.note: awful suggests the letters are in a dreadful state and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper with a dreadful conceit.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrogance is overbearing self-importance, a form of excessive pride.

clue.text: Orientals drink at river joints, they say

parts.note: a nip is a small drink
the Po is the great river of northern Italy

indicators.note: they say signals a word heard rather than spelt

parts.note: knees are joints of the leg

explanation.surface: Easterners have a drink at the river, and their joints creak.
explanation.definitionFit: Nippon is the Japanese name for Japan, so its people are Japanese.

clue.text: Makes eyes at a man on turning to leave

indicators.note: on places the man's name after the other piece
turning means the word for leaving is read backwards

parts.note: to go is to leave
Les is a man's name

explanation.surface: A fellow flirts as he turns to depart.
explanation.definitionFit: To ogle someone is to look at them with obvious desire.

clue.text: Legislate to reverse punishment one's taken from it

indicators.note: to reverse means the word for punishment is turned backwards

parts.note: the cane was a school punishment

indicators.note: taken from means a letter is removed from the word it

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral; one's is one is

explanation.surface: A lawmaker undoes a punishment, then removes one person from it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to reverse' turns CANE into ENAC; 'one's taken from it' leaves T from IT.
explanation.definitionFit: To enact a bill is to pass it into law.

clue.text: Newspaper boss's fixer

parts.note: the press means newspapers
a boss is a raised stud or knob

explanation.surface: An editor-in-chief's go-to troubleshooter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fixer' is not a shady operator but a fastener.
explanation.definitionFit: A popper that snaps shut on clothing, a small fastener.

clue.text: Sequences of explosions heard on the battlefield?

definitions.meaning: in an engine, the order in which cylinders ignite
commands to shoot shouted to soldiers

explanation.surface: Bangs in sequence ring out in combat.
explanation.definitionFit: Engineers name the ignition sequence of cylinders this way, and officers shout such commands so troops shoot.

clue.text: Force right into the joint

indicators.note: into places the abbreviation for right inside the word for a joint

parts.note: a dive is a seedy joint or bar

explanation.surface: Someone shoves a righteous blow into a joint.
explanation.definitionFit: Drive means push forward with force, as in drive a nail.

clue.text: Trendy accountant who lived in S. America

parts.note: in means fashionable
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A fashionable bookkeeper who once lived in South America.
explanation.definitionFit: The Inca were the people of the Andean empire conquered by Spain.

clue.text: Strapping girl?

parts.note: a falconer's leg strap for a hawk, which is also a girl's name

explanation.definitionFit: A falconry term for the short leather strap on a hawk's leg, and a short form of Jessica.

clue.text: Admits having no points

parts.note: O is a zero, no amount
W, N and S are three compass points: west, north and south

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to having no sense of direction.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up is to confess, so in this sense it means acknowledges.

clue.text: Withstanding underground movement

definitions.meaning: a secret organisation opposing an occupying power

explanation.surface: Holding out as an underground group.
explanation.definitionFit: The act of standing firm against force, and the secret wartime fighters against occupation, notably in France.

clue.text: One who fastens the line

definitions.meaning: a person who ties things up
a row, as of seats in a theatre

explanation.surface: Someone tying up the rope.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who ties knots, and a row of seating one above another.

clue.text: "As in the lowly air of" (Gilbert)

parts.note: the line from Iolanthe is completed by the name of a London district once notorious as a slum

explanation.walkthrough: In Gilbert and Sullivan's Iolanthe the peers sing that hearts beat as true in high places 'as in the lowly air of' a poor area near Covent Garden.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a road junction in London's West End, near Covent Garden, where several streets meet at a pillar of sundials.
